issues.title: X-axis label clipping
issues.description: The initial x-axis label is cut off at the left boundary.
issues.evidence: The '00' timestamp on the bottom-left of the chart is clipped.
issues.suggestion: Increase chart side margins or offset the initial x-axis tick label.
issues.triageNote: Verified real: with a numeric XAxis interval (interval={2} on pair-007) recharts skips its edge-tick clamping (getTicks.js returns getNumberIntervalTicks), so the first tick '00' at x=5 with text-anchor=middle renders with bbox left = -2px, clipped by the SVG viewport. Fixed in ChartContainer by adding px-2 so the ResponsiveContainer/SVG is inset 8px from the card edge, giving edge tick labels clearance (symmetric, RTL-safe).
